title.en: the veteran cars leave hyde park at dawn.
title.de: die oldtimer fahren im morgengrauen aus dem hyde park.
title.tr: veteran arabalar şafakta hyde park'tan çıkıyor.

line.en: the london to brighton veteran car run starts in hyde park on sunday. in past years the cars left between seven and half eight; go early and watch them line up.
line.de: der london-brighton veteranenlauf startet am sonntag im hyde park. in den vorjahren fuhren die wagen zwischen sieben und halb neun los; komm früh und schau beim aufstellen zu.
line.tr: london-brighton veteran araba yarışı pazar günü hyde park'ta başlıyor. önceki yıllarda arabalar yedi ile sekiz buçuk arasında çıktı; erken git ve dizilişi izle.

sparks.why: London to Brighton Veteran Car Run starts in Hyde Park on Sun 1 Nov 2026 (Octane Magazine and RM Sotheby's VCC listings); the 2026 start time is not confirmed, the 7 to 8.30 am window is from past years. Sunrise 06:54 per one timetable.

title.en: sunday upmarket in the truman brewery.
title.de: sunday upmarket in der truman brewery.

line.en: vintage, fashion and food stalls under the brewery arches, open from ten on sundays. a slow wander for the late morning, a short walk from brick lane.
line.de: vintage, mode und essensstände unter den bögen der brauerei, sonntags ab zehn. ein ruhiger spaziergang für den späten vormittag, nah an der brick lane.
line.tr: brewery kemerlerinin altında vintage, moda ve yemek standları, pazar günleri on'dan itibaren açık. öğlene doğru sakin bir gezinti, brick lane'e yakın.

sparks.why: Sunday UpMarket in the Truman Brewery, Brick Lane, runs Sundays per London & Partners and Wikipedia's Brick Lane Market listings (10am to 5pm or 6pm, sources differ); not checked on the venue site.
